question: Gill starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards south. She then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 4 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 5 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Gill starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards south.
 
• She then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 4 km.
 
• She then takes a left turn and drives 5 km.
 
• She takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P
